newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Grain Exchange president Mori dies of cancer.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Grain Exchange president Mori dies of cancer.

text.p: The Tokyo Grain Exchange (TGE) said on Monday that its president Seiji Mori died of cancer at the weekend. He was 72.

Mori, a former Agriculture Ministry official, took over as president in May 1989 and was behind the launching of a yen-based corn futures contract in 1992 and a U.S. soybean futures option contract in 1991.
The exchange said it would hold an extraordinary board meeting from 12.30 p.m. today (0330 GMT) to pick a new president.
The TGE is one of the largest commodity exchanges in Japan.
